description: This file contains PHP classes that implement compilation logic for 'for', 'forelse', and 'forclose' tags within the Smarty template engine. These classes generate PHP code for looping constructs used in Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_For
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {for} Smarty template tag, supporting different loop syntaxes and generating corresponding PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Forelse
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {forelse} Smarty template tag, providing an 'else' block for loops.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Forclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/for} Smarty template tag, closing loop blocks.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the corresponding Smarty loop tags based on provided attributes and parameters.
